column1: # AQL Language Specification: Higher-order list words (each fold scan join)
# each / fold / scan take an unevaluated CODE BODY (NoEvalArgs) as their
# first argument and a collection as the second; the body runs against
# each element on the stack. fold/scan optionally take an initial
# accumulator. (filter, which takes a Function callback, and the richer
# combinators — where/group/unique/sortby — live in the aql:array module.)
# §1  each — map a code body over a list

column3: the body may use stack ops

column1: # §2  fold — reduce a list with a binary body

column3: no-init form folds from the first element

column1: # §4  join — concatenate list elements into a String
# §5  filter — keep elements whose callback returns true. The callback is
#     a Function (not a code body) and receives a {key value} PAIR map per
#     element (key = index for a list, the map key for a map); read the
#     element via `.value`. The afn param must be typed, e.g. [p:Any].
filter ([p:Any] => [(p.value mod 2) eq 0]) {a:1 b:2 c:3 d:4}
column3: filter also walks a map's values
